summary: One 'Button' component set (92 variants) covering Text, Action, Icon, Dropdown/Split and Dual Icon types across Light, Dark and a V2 'Studio' theme, plus small sets for AI Copilot, Show more and an arrow icon. Documentation sits in a .documentation block, a 'Button' doc frame and two dev-spec templates, with a large Draft Workspace of old explorations off to the side.

items.name: Text Button / Primary / Light
items.use: Normal 30px tall (pad 6/10/8/10, gap 10), Small 24px (pad 5/10/5/10). Radius 4. Default fill #0076DD pando-blue, white label. Hover: white fill + 1px #0076DD border, blue label. Loading: same as Hover plus a 16px (14px Small) raster spinner image, width grows to 123/113. Disabled: #E7E7E7 grey-light fill, #545454 text-medium label. Labels uppercase Open Sans Bold 12px (style Button/Normal-Bold) / 10px 14px LH (Button/Small-Bold).
items.html: Button TextButton TextButton TextButton Text
flags: Hover and Loading look the same (white fill, blue border); Loading only adds the spinner
Loading spinner is a raster IMAGE layer ('826 1'), not a vector or component
White on #0076DD = 4.53:1, just passes 4.5 (note for the accessibility pass)
warn: Vertical padding is uneven (6 top / 8 bottom) on Normal but even (5/5) on Small
Hover inverts the button instead of darkening it; pando-blue-active #005399 exists in tokens but is not used

items.name: Text Button / Secondary / Light (+ Red, Green)
items.use: Same sizes, padding and radius as Primary. Default #EEF2F4 pando-light fill, #0076DD label. Hover and Loading identical to Primary (white fill, #0076DD border). Disabled #E7E7E7 / #545454. Red state: #EEF2F4 fill with #E25757 action-red label. Green state (Normal only): label stays #0076DD.
items.html: Button TextButton TextButton TextButton TextGreen = Default
flags: 'Green' state (3142:1288) is identical to Default: label #0076DD, no green anywhere
Secondary Hover is the same as Primary Hover, so the two lose their difference on hover
#0076DD on #EEF2F4 = 4.02:1 and #E25757 on #EEF2F4 = 3.25:1, below 4.5 (accessibility pass)
warn: Red/Green are colour tones but sit in the State property next to Hover/Disabled, so a red button can't also be hovered or disabled

items.name: Text Button / Dark theme (Primary + Secondary)
items.use: Primary Default #0076DD / white. Primary Hover: no fill, 1px #9CD2FF highlight-blue-light border, white label. Primary Disabled #393945 dark-bg / #A3A3A3. Secondary Default #393945 / white; Hover #24242F dark-darker fill + #393945 border; Disabled #393945 / #A3A3A3; Small Red #393945 / #E25757. Dark Primary Small also has a Loading (same as hover + spinner).
items.html: Button TextButton TextButton TextButton TextButton Text
flags: Fill style is named 'Dark/Dark-Bg-#393944' but the value is #393945
Primary Disabled and Secondary Default share the same #393945 fill; only label colour separates them
warn: Dark theme has no Normal Loading and no Normal Red for Secondary; coverage is uneven against Light
items.rec: Keep, fill in the missing states later

Button TextButton TextButton Text
Button TextButton Text

Fill style named 'Accent/Light-Highlight-#EFF3F5' but the value is #E9F1F5
#A3A3A3 disabled on white = 2.52:1 (disabled is exempt; note only)
warn: Hit area is 14-16px tall, below the 24px minimum target (see target-size gap)
Dark theme has no Hover

items.name: Theme = Studio (Text Button + Dropdown)
items.use: Primary fill is gradient style 'Gradient/Linear/Pi-Green' (#041F04 to #343440) with white label; Hover white fill + gradient border + gradient label. Secondary #EEF2F4 fill with gradient label. Studio Dropdown label #003D31 'Primary/Pando-Green'. Labels are Open Sans Bold 12/10 but sentence case, with no text style attached.
items.html: Button TextButton TextButton TextLabel
flags: Gradient #041F04 to #343440 and #003D31 are not in V1 tokens.css
Studio labels have no text style and are not uppercase, unlike every Light/Dark label
Style is called 'Pi-Green' but renders near-black
warn: Studio is the V2 brand; a V2 theme living inside the V1 button set mixes the two systems. Confirm whether it belongs here
items.rec: Outdated? Decide if Studio stays in V1

items.name: Action Button
items.use: Transparent, pad 3/5/3/5, gap 4, height 22. 10px icon (instance '10px/Type=LR') + uppercase label Open Sans SemiBold 12px (style Button/Action-Semibold). Light: #376F99 action-blue; Red #E25757; Green #91C38A; Disabled #A3A3A3; Hover and Active: #E9F1F5 fill, radius 4. Dark: white label, Hover #8A8A9E fill.
items.html: Button TextButton TextButton Text
flags: Hover and Active are identical (#E9F1F5)
Radius is 0 at Default but 4 at Hover
#91C38A green label on white = 2.02:1; #E25757 = 3.66:1; dark hover white on #8A8A9E = 3.38:1 (accessibility pass)

items.use: Circular: 30px (20px icon) and 20px (14px icon), #EEF2F4 circle. Default icon #234357 with shadow 0 2 3 #000 10% (= shadow-1, style 'Shadow/White BG/0-1-3-10%'); Hover icon #376F99, no shadow; Disabled circle #E7E7E7, icon #9C9C9C. No Background: same sizes, Delete icon #234357, Hover adds a white circle, Disabled #A3A3A3.
flags: Disabled icon #9C9C9C has no colour style and is not in tokens.css
Shadow style name says 0-1-3 but the value is 0 2 3
No Background Hover adds a #FFFFFF circle, invisible on a white page
Small Disabled is filed under Variant '-' while its siblings are 'Circular Background'
Small variant frame radius 12 / 0 while its circle radius is 15
warn: Small size is 20x20, under the 24px minimum target
Only the Small Circular Default lacks the shadow that Normal Default has

Disabled label #9C9C9C is unregistered

items.name: Button Dropdown + Split
items.use: Dropdown: Secondary only. Normal 30px pad 7/10/7/10, Small 24px pad 5/10; #EEF2F4 fill, #0076DD label + 10x8 'Navigation/Button-Down-Caret'. Loading: white + #0076DD border (Small pad 4). Split frame fill #FFFFFF has no style
No Hover or Disabled for dropdowns

items.name: Dual Icon
items.use: '-' variant: two stacked 24x24 squares, gap 2. Cancel (.Button/Cancel) #E7E7E7 fill with #515151 close icon; Confirm (.Button/Confirm) #0076DD with white check; pad 6. Circular Background: 51x24 pill, #E2EAEC border-input-light fill, radius 20, two #234357 right carets.
flags: Circular 'Normal/Default' and 'Small/Active' are the same 51x24 frame with the same fill: size and state do nothing
Padding 10 on all sides inside a 24px-tall frame (content overflows the padding box)
Three loose components in Draft Workspace reuse the exact variant name 'Theme=Light, Type=Dual Icon, Variant=-, Size=Small, State=Default'

items.name: AI Copilot Button (+ Pi standalone)

Light Hover adds 1px gradient border (#FF8C54 to #8D00DF) and label 'AI-Powered Suggestions' in teal gradient (#006265 to #19A476), style 12px/Heading. Dark Default gradient fill #FF4DA6 to #FE6505. Standalone 'AI Copilot Button/Pi/Default' + '/Hover' (86x30) use teal Pi gradients.

Hover mixes three brand gradients (pink-orange logo, orange-purple border, teal label)
Style '12px/Heading' is not in the V1 type list
Pi Default/Hover are loose COMPONENTs outside the set

items.name: Show more / Show less
items.use: 156x14 row, gap 5: divider line, Text Only Small button 'Show more'/'Show Less', 14px .arrow-right caret, divider line. Hover uses Text Only Hover (#E9F1F5 / #234357).

Copy case differs: 'Show more' vs 'Show Less'

items.name: State property mixes states and tones
items.use: State options: Default, Disabled, Hover, Loading, Active, Red, Green. Variant options include '-', 'Split', 'Text Only', 'Circular Background'. 92 variants in the set; many Type x Variant x State combos are missing (e.g. no Disabled dropdown, no Dark Normal Loading, no Studio Disabled).
flags: Red and Green are colour tones but are modelled as States, so they can't combine with Hover/Disabled
No Focus state exists for any type
warn: Consider a separate Tone/Danger property when rebuilding

items.name: Label text styles
items.use: Button/Normal-Bold: Open Sans Bold 12, auto line height, 0 tracking, UPPER. Button/Small-Bold: Open Sans Bold 10/14, 0 tracking, UPPER (= type-10-bold + caps, but caps adds 0.5px tracking). Button/Action-Semibold: Open Sans SemiBold 12, auto LH, UPPER. Icons: 'Indicator Icon/Add', 'Indicator Icon/Delete' 20/14px, 'Navigation/Button-Down-Caret' 10x8, '10px/Type=LR'.
flags: Button/Normal-Bold (12 Bold, auto LH) has no match: type-12-bold is 12/14
Button/Action-Semibold (12 SemiBold) has no match in the type list
Buttons are uppercase with 0 tracking; .caps class adds 0.5px
warn: Auto line height renders ~16px for 12px Open Sans

items.name: .documentation block (Overview / Uses / Placement)
items.use: Overview: buttons trigger actions, labels say what happens. Uses: Primary once per screen; Secondary only with a Primary; Text Only for the negative action of a pair ('Cancel', 'Back'); text/icon/both, sometimes with a tooltip. Placement & Convention: buttons generally placed to the right, visible without scrolling.
flags: Placement says buttons go to the right; Template 2 'Alignment' text says the primary goes on the left of full-page designs (contradiction)
Placement sentence is missing a word ('right of the screen  should be')
warn: Covers only Primary/Secondary/Text Only; Action, Icon, Dropdown, Dual Icon, pill are not described here

items.name: 'Button' doc frame (Overview, Behaviour, Do/Don't, Types)
items.use: Overview, Behaviour (one primary per page), Do/Don't (no more than 1 primary in a group; don't put 2 icons in one button), and a description for each type: icon button (tooltip needed for icon-only), Button Dropdown, Dual icon, Text button (label centred), Action button.
flags: 'Don't put 2 icons in the same button' conflicts with the Dual Icon type defined on the same page
Button Dropdown description is marketing-style and cut off mid-sentence ('this button o')
warn: Typos: 'Dont', 'buttons text label'
items.rec: Keep, trim and align with Dual Icon

items.name: .Button/Confirm and .Button/Cancel
items.use: Private 24x24 building blocks for Dual Icon: Confirm #0076DD with white 'Navigation/Selected' check, Cancel #E7E7E7 with #515151 grey-dark 'Navigation/Close-Tag'; pad 6.

items.name: No focus state
items.use: No variant shows a keyboard focus ring. WCAG 2.4.7 needs a visible focus indicator; Carbon notes buttons are triggered with Enter or Space while focused.
warn: Focus indicator also needs 3:1 against adjacent colours (1.4.11)

items.name: Loading is not a real state
items.use: V1 Loading reuses the hover style with a raster spinner, and the pill 'Loading' has no indicator. Carbon shows inline loading with the button disabled while loading; Ant Design has a 'loading' prop with optional delay and icon.

items.name: Icon-only buttons: accessible name + tooltip rule
items.use: Icon Buttons have no label or tooltip slot. Carbon: a tooltip is always required for icon buttons. WCAG 4.1.2: the control needs a programmatic name (e.g. aria-label). Fluent: icons need 3:1 contrast.
warn: The 'Button' doc frame already says icon-only buttons need a tooltip; the component doesn't carry it

items.name: Target size under 24px
items.use: Small icon buttons are 20x20, Text Only is 14-16px tall, Action Button 22px. WCAG 2.5.8 asks for 24x24 CSS px or enough spacing around smaller targets.

items.name: Danger as a proper variant
items.use: V1 has Red only as a State on Secondary/Action/Text Only; there is no red filled primary. Carbon offers danger in primary, tertiary and ghost styles and says danger should not be icon-only; Ant Design has a 'danger' prop that works across types.

items.name: Disabled guidance
items.use: V1 docs (Template 2) say to give context for disabled buttons, but nothing defines how. Fluent: show a tooltip explaining what is unavailable and why; disabled buttons don't need to meet contrast.

items.name: Only two sizes
items.use: V1 has Normal (30) and Small (24) only; Action and pill have one size each. Ant Design offers small/medium/large plus 'block' full-width; Carbon offers seven sizes.
warn: Not necessarily needed for V1; flag for discussion

notReadable: Loading spinner is a raster image ('826 1'); its colours could not be read as values
Draft Workspace contents (Spec 1280x8975, Template 3, Flow) were inventoried by name/size only, not walked
Studio-theme text styles: none attached, so no style name to report
